data.job_title: Research Intern – LLMs, SLMs & Generative AI
data.skills:
Preferred Skills:
•	Experience with LLMs, SLMs, or Generative AI projects.
•	Familiarity with: 
o	Fine-tuning and instruction tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, Model evaluation and benchmarking, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
o	Data engineering and preprocessing pipelines
•	Research publications, academic projects, open-source contributions, or participation in AI competitions are a plus.
data.eligibility_information:
60% or above in academics across 10th, 12th, UG, PG and PhD
No Standing arrears at the time of interview
data.additional_information:
About the Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated Research Intern from IITs or IIITH or IISc to join our AI Research team. The intern will contribute to the research and development of domain-specific Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and Generative AI solutions for enterprise applications.
The role offers an opportunity to work on cutting-edge research problems involving model fine-tuning, data-centric AI, domain adaptation, and efficient language model development. The intern will collaborate with experienced researchers and engineers to build, evaluate, and optimize language models for real-world use cases.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct research on advanced NLP, LLM, and SLM techniques.
• Fine-tune foundation models for domain-specific and task-specific applications.
• Design and implement data preprocessing, cleaning, annotation, and curation pipelines.
• Build and evaluate datasets for model training and adaptation.
• Experiment with parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, and PEFT.
• Benchmark and compare open-source language models across various tasks.
• Develop and evaluate models for applications such as: 
o Information Extraction, Text Classification, Question Answering, Summarization, Conversational AI, Knowledge Retrieval
• Study and reproduce findings from recent research papers.
• Analyze model performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Document research findings and present results through technical reports and project reviews.

Required Qualifications:
• Currently pursuing M.Tech, MS (Research), or PhD at IITs or IIITH or IISc in:
o Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computational Linguistics & Related disciplines
• Strong academic background in Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing.
• Proficiency in Python programming.
• Good understanding of:
o Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Probability and Statistics, Data Structures and Algorithms
• Familiarity with:
o PyTorch or TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, Git
data.additional_details:
Research Areas:
The intern will have the opportunity to work on:
• Domain-Specific Language Models
• Task-Specific LLM Development
• Small Language Models (SLMs)
• Fine-Tuning and Model Adaptation
• Data-Centric AI
• Synthetic Data Generation
• Model Compression and Distillation
• Enterprise NLP Applications
• LLM Evaluation and Benchmarking
________________________________________
Expected Outcomes:
By the end of the internship, the candidate is expected to:
• Develop and evaluate one or more task-specific language models.
• Build reusable data preprocessing and model training pipelines.
• Produce benchmark reports and research findings.
• Contribute to technical publications, patents, whitepapers, or internal research artifacts.
• Deliver prototype solutions demonstrating measurable improvements in target NLP tasks.
